svg.text: 2026-11-15 · STAGE 491 · TOPIC 131 · SVG 135 🎉 · 133RD FAQ · 494 DIMS · 🎉 HISTORIC 135TH SVG & 985-GUARDRAIL MILESTONE (P975–P976 🎉)
SIP RFC 7852 / RFC 6881 NG911 EmergencyCallData: Call-Info SSRF & MIME Block Quota Guard
P975 cid: By-Value / [1, 4] mTLS ADR Allowlist & urn:service:sos Binding · P976 🎉 [1, 4] MIME Blocks & [1, 32]KB XML Cap
❌ Unprotected RFC 7852 EmergencyCallData Risks
1. Call-Info By-Reference SSRF & Spoofed Queue Jump (RFC 7852)
• Call-Info: <http://169.254.169.254/...>;purpose=EmergencyCallData
• Gateway auto-fetches URL → cloud IMDS / internal network SSRF!
• Commercial caller spoofs EmergencyCallData without urn:service:sos
2. By-Value Multipart XML Bomb (24 MIME Blocks / 512KB XML)
• Attaches 24 EmergencyCallData.*+xml parts totaling 512KB in INVITE
• Exhausts SBC XML DOM parser & overflows 64KB SIP buffer
• Delays genuine life-safety emergency triage routing!
Enterprise Production Impact (Without P975–P976)
• Internal metadata credentials leaked via Call-Info dereference
• Oversized XML attachments stall PSAP / eCall bridge setup
Verdict: BLOCK (Call-Info ADR SSRF / Multipart XML Bomb)
✅ Deterministic RFC 7852 / RFC 6881 NG911 Guards (P975–P976 🎉)
P975: cid: By-Value / [1, 4] mTLS ADR Allowlist & SOS Binding
• Require cid: by-value or [1, 4] mTLS-authenticated ADR domains
• Strip EmergencyCallData on non-SOS commercial calls (RFC 6881)
• Block 100% of plaintext HTTP / RFC 1918 / IMDS Call-Info URIs
• untrustedCallInfoSsrfOrSpoofedEmergencyPreemptions == 0
• Gate: evaluateSipRfc7852EmergencyCallDataCallInfoByValue...()
P976 🎉 (985th Guard / 135th SVG): [1, 4] MIME Blocks & [1, 32]KB Cap
• Cap EmergencyCallData MIME body parts in [1, 4] per INVITE
• Clamp aggregate EmergencyCallData XML payload in [1, 32] KB
• Truncate non-critical XML blocks while preserving SOS voice path
• oversizedOrExcessEmergencyCallDataMimeDrops == 0
• Gate: evaluateSipRfc7852EmergencyCallDataMimeBlockCount...()
Verdict: PASS (0 Call-Info SSRF · [1, 32]KB XML · 933 Tests)
